verification: Exact rational arithmetic (Python fractions, outside the repository, 2026-11-26): (40 + 42)/2 x 50 = 2 050; (42 + 19)/2 x 50 = 1 525; (19 + 34)/2 x 50 = 1 325; total 4 900 m3, as printed. The source calls these end areas of an earthwork volume without saying cut or fill, so they are entered as cut areas (fill areas zero); the volume is the same. The method is average_end_area because the source applies it to every segment. Tolerance 0.5 m3 as recorded for C1 in planning/REFERENCE_CASES.md.
